description: mods (function hooks, under CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1): the to-human view of the transcript — from the first message on, assistant messages draw as their marked spans and the working record (unmarked messages, tool calls and their results, agent messages, notifications, and messages delivered from other sessions) folds behind [ working record ] buttons; the band above the prompt switches between the report and the full transcript; the message tool (mcp__to-human__message, always loaded in an interactive session under the doperpowers:to-human output style, but not under MAWS) sends a message before another tool call word for word, drawn where the call sits; each main-conversation message, a response row's <message> span as the row is kept or an accepted message-tool call as it runs, raises a notification ($.ui.notify: the person's Notification hooks read it as plugin_notification, then their notification channel)
